frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The plans illustrate the layout changes of a small theatre between 2010 and 2012.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while the stage and auditorium remained in their original positions, the theatre underwent significant renovations, with most support facilities being relocated and two new rooms being added.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Starting with the northern section of the theatre, the stage retained its central position directly above the auditorium throughout the period. However, the dressing room, which originally occupied a large area in the north, was considerably reduced in size and relocated to the western side of the building by 2012, with a new shower facility added adjacent to it. In its place, a new coordination room was introduced, while the admin office was repositioned to the northeast corner, having been moved from its original location in the southwest.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the southern section, the auditorium with its three rows of seating remained unchanged throughout the two-year period. The storage area was relocated from the northwest corner to the southwest, while in place of the former admin and ticket offices, a larger restaurant was constructed. Meanwhile, the ticket office was moved to the southeast corner, where the cafe had previously been located, and the main door retained its central position at the front of the building.
